rows.text: In Vonwacq, some outsiders block your path. You size them up and realize they aren't locals. While the Vonwacq still uses stone tools, these people are wearing materials from a technologically advanced planet.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "The 60-natural-year cycle is about to start again, and Vonwacq's Cyclic Demon Lord will be born from the fruit of a certain type of tree. We're here to wipe this data from the biological database, as the Cyclic Demon Lord is just an alien bug!" A man declared.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Once the Demon Lord emerges from the fruit and lands on the ground, it will deal a devastating blow to our civilization. Calculations show that we are just f—f—four cycles away from its arrival!" Another outsider remarks in a trembling voice.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
